name: plan-agent
description: Plan creation and review on demand — /plan-agent:implementation-plan skill runs the full Steps 1-8 workflow with a built-in structured interview; /plan-agent:review-plan skill spawns an Agent Team (5 core + 2 UI-conditional reviewers) to review, improve, and update implementation plans in place; /plan-agent:finalize-plan skill checks completion evidence and sets status; /plan-agent:build skill implements an existing plan end-to-end behind acceptance, end-to-end, and completion gates; /plan-agent:build-proposal skill turns a vague idea into a decision-complete proposal under docs/proposals/ via an 8-step research-then-decide loop with a Tier 0/1/2 gate, then hands off to implementation-plan; plans-library generates a filterable HTML gallery; /plan-agent:setup-sites skill scaffolds the GitHub Pages deploy pipeline into any repo so generated docs/ HTML publishes to a public URL; /plan-agent:prototype skill turns a completed HTML plan or a one-line idea into a runnable, framework-free static-HTML prototype under docs/prototypes/, auto-indexed into a Prototypes gallery; filename hook enforces verb-target kebab-case
